pair.title: Connect Guardian Eye
pair.description: In Guardian Eye, open the Home Assistant settings, select Connect Home Assistant and copy the code. HA will share its MQTT connection settings with GE.

manual.title: Guardian Eye
manual.description: Enter the Guardian Eye URL and a token with camera viewing permission. The token stays on the Home Assistant server.

error.mqtt_required: Set up the MQTT integration in Home Assistant first, then try again.
